QURIOUSCRAFTINGRELICS-ENABLE_CHAOS_RELIC: When off: chaos relics stop generating, the reward pool returns to vanilla relics, owned chaos relics have no effect.
Extra pool adds non-vanilla-relic effects: hand retain/sly/ethereal, enchantments (sharp/nimble/imbued), retain triggers, watcher stances (requires the Watcher mod). Off by default; when on, these templates join the generation pool. Both MP ends must match.
QURIOUSCRAFTINGRELICS-CHAOS_RELIC_MULTIP: Does not affect generation since the v0.5 point-budget system (kept for save compatibility).
QURIOUSCRAFTINGRELICS-CHAOS_RELIC_BUDGET: Point budget for Common chaos relics. Positive entries cost points; negative entries refund points. Default 10.
Point budget for Uncommon chaos relics. Default 16.
Point budget for Rare chaos relics. Default 24.
QURIOUSCRAFTINGRELICS-CHAOS_RELIC_NEGATI: Percent chance a Common chaos relic carries one negative entry. Default 35.
Percent chance an Uncommon chaos relic carries one negative entry. Default 55.
Percent chance a Rare chaos relic carries one negative entry. Default 75.
QURIOUSCRAFTINGRELICS-COST_C_START_DAMAG: Per point: combat-start damage to all
QURIOUSCRAFTINGRELICS-COST_C_START_VULN_: Per point: combat-start Vulnerable to all
QURIOUSCRAFTINGRELICS-COST_C_START_WEAK_: Per point: combat-start Weak to all
QURIOUSCRAFTINGRELICS-COST_C_START_POISO: Per point: combat-start Poison to all (triangular)
QURIOUSCRAFTINGRELICS-COST_PLAY_DAMAGE_R: Per point: on-play damage to random enemy
QURIOUSCRAFTINGRELICS-REFUND_N_TURN_LOSE: Refund per point: per-turn HP loss
QURIOUSCRAFTINGRELICS-REFUND_N_TURN_ENER: Refund per point: max energy down
QURIOUSCRAFTINGRELICS-REFUND_N_REST_HEAL: Refund per point: rest heal down
QURIOUSCRAFTINGRELICS-REFUND_N_ATTACK_DA: Refund per point: attack damage down
QURIOUSCRAFTINGRELICS-REFUND_N_MAX_HP_DO: Refund per point: max HP down
QURIOUSCRAFTINGRELICS-SETTINGS_PAGE_UNAV: Settings page unavailable (BaseLib missing or incompatible).
